name: WatsonOM-MemorySweep
description: Hourly isolated Watson Memory sweep with Codex-only usage tracking and stale transcript checks.

payload.message: HOURLY OM SWEEP. Run `python3 scripts/token_tracker.py report --date $(date -u +%F) --write` to refresh the Codex-only ledger summary and hourly cache, then run `python3 scripts/token_tracker.py status --date $(date -u +%F)` for the active-subagent/token snapshot. After that, inspect `memory/` for stale transcript artifacts, flag any memory file over 200 lines for relocation to `reports/openclaw/`, keep `MEMORY.md` under ~60 lines (compact only if it drifts over), and append one concise audit note plus at most one evidence-backed observation when the sweep finds a reusable hygiene signal.
